items.title: Veralto (VLTO) Buys Alfaa UV To Grow Its Water Treatment Reach In India
items.summary: Veralto (NYSE:VLTO) has acquired Indian ultraviolet water treatment company Alfaa UV. Alfaa UV will be integrated into Veralto’s Trojan Technologies unit to expand its UV water treatment portfolio. The deal adds a broader commercial presence for Veralto in India and the wider Asia-Pacific region.
